caption:
Someone already imagined what rush hour would look like with Tesla's new flying Roadster. 💀

AI creator iamneubert made a hilarious video showing a driver getting impatient in traffic and deciding to take a shortcut straight into the sky.

The video comes just after Tesla demonstrated its next-generation Roadster performing aerial stunts using experimental thruster technology.

While the traffic scene is entirely AI-generated, the real-world demonstration has already sparked plenty of ideas about what people would do with a car capable of leaving the ground.

Would you use this to skip traffic? 😂
